svg.text: 640 x 480 px · ~30 fps | Each pixel = Y (brightness) + U, V (colour tint)
U and V colour channels are discarded. Each cell = one number 0-255 (0=black · 255=white)
step = scaleFactor.coerceAtLeast(1) -> read every Nth pixel
③ Downsample — skip every N pixels
step=8: 640->80 cols, 480->60 rows. (step=2 shown here for clarity)
LUT[g] = ((g - 128) x 1.2 + 128).coerceIn(0, 255) · Darks crushed darker · Brights boosted brighter
0xFF shl 24 or g shl 16 or g shl 8 or g -> ARGB int
One ARGB int per pixel. Same IntArray reused every frame — zero allocation, zero GC pressure.
IntArray[12] (grows to frame_width x frame_height, never shrinks)
displayMode? -> IMAGE branch or ASCII branch
⑥ Display — Compose recomposition on main thread
IMAGE: Bitmap.setPixels() -> Image() composable | ASCII: glyphForIntensity[g] -> Canvas.drawText()
